propositions: The resolved_statuses config keys (jira and reconciler) became inert after task f020 deleted the inbound absence-probe port and its only reader classify_probe_response
The keys were live and behavior-affecting in shipped release v0.10.1 where operators were documented to set them, making hard removal an upgrade hazard without operator sign-off
Both keys must remain accepted and validated for backward compatibility while emitting deprecation warnings and scheduled for removal in v1.0.0
The write-only datacenter transport plumbing (_resolved_statuses attribute, NamedTuple field, DEFAULT_RESOLVED_STATUSES constant) must be removed as it has no readers
Schema fields must be marked with read-via pointers to a follow-up hard-removal ticket, and documentation must describe both keys as deprecated pending operator decision
